scope: Project execution settings, connection preflight and persisted choice validation. Not completion of the entire product plan.

unit.command: pnpm exec vitest run tests/execution-profiles.test.ts tests/agent-verification.test.ts tests/agent-recovery.test.ts

cases.name: durable implementation recovery recovers after the writing process exits mid-apply, including an outdated progress list
durable implementation recovery reconciles a partial undo but refuses to overwrite any subsequent user edit
durable implementation recovery restores review, applies, restarts again, and undoes without losing the saved design
durable implementation recovery persists explicit scope and test review, rejects stale proposals and preserves uncertainty
durable implementation recovery invalidates old approvals and checks when the agent connection is lost
durable implementation recovery invalidates a completed review if its files change after restart
durable implementation recovery persists a real failed launch and restores it without launching another process
durable implementation recovery rejects corrupt records, forged source paths, and snapshot hashes before restoring
durable implementation recovery excludes a second writer until its lease is released
durable implementation recovery excludes another process and releases the lease after its owner is killed
durable implementation recovery can acquire an IPC lease while an unrelated service holds the former TCP port
independent implementation verification records real exits, refuses missing or replaced scripts, and terminates timed-out commands
independent implementation verification cancels a running check only after its actual child and descendant stop
project execution settings restores the exact reviewed choices locally and isolates another project
project execution settings revocation survives reopen and cannot be undone by a stale open window
project execution settings rejects changed launcher, model, manager, scripts, project, and check selections before starting
project execution settings serializes approval use against another process store without silently restoring a revoked record
project execution settings preserves malformed records instead of replacing them with a new approval

checks: unfinished draft persists separately without confirming design or starting an agent
explicit design save consumes only its persisted draft revision
changed design blocks stale draft confirmation and explicit comparison preserves input
changed package script invalidates saved execution settings and blocks implementation before design save
revoked execution settings cannot be reused by a stale UI request
stale baseline comparison and stale spec revision are rejected
renamed declaration explicitly reconnects with stable spec identity
baseline history and desired intent survive subsequent document edits
baseline acceptance never starts an agent
cross-folder business feature stores canonical code membership
feature grouping does not change source or start an agent
feature removal preserves code and marks saved design for reconnection
feature removal waits for an overlapping analysis before acknowledging completion
external atomic replacement is analyzed from disk while the document is open

browser.method: Cua browser interaction with actual ImplementationOptions component, synthetic callbacks only. No actual CLI or external model in browser fixture.
observed: initial implementation disabled without consent and checks
unrelated progress update retains edited selection
saved choices restore after page reload
saved implementation request contains profileRevision and useSaved
one-time changed selection still contains profileRevision
changed script clears consent and disables implementation
revoke clears consent and selected checks
untrusted state disables checkboxes and connection
connection test response displayed without clearing choices

limitations: Installed tests use the real packaged host and deterministic stdio peer, not a live model.
Browser fixture is separate from installed VS Code Webview.
No end-to-end installed UI and live-model run established by this change.
Profile binds configured strings, not executable bytes, PATH, CLI defaults, package manager versions or all test source files.
